pipeline_params.description: Chuzom v2.0.0: 4-gate parallel ensemble with confidence-weighted smart score. Gate 1: TF-IDF+LR (lexical). Gate 2: BGE-small centroid cosine (semantic, paraphrase-invariant). Gate 3: Structural heuristic (regex domain signals). Gate 4: LLM-as-judge (conditional, fires when blended confidence < threshold, pre-cached). Smart score amplifies gates with strong signal margins. Early-exit when all active gates agree with high confidence. Routing based solely on prompt content — no benchmark metadata.

description: Chuzom Router v2.0.0 — 4-gate parallel ensemble with LLM-as-judge tie-breaker.
